crossRefs.note: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and…
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn…
that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these…
then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it…
Cretans and Arabians: we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…

translations.web: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
translations.bsb: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
translations.kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
translations.asv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.
